sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND (
      h.intervation_approaches IN (
          'Individual counseling',
          'Peer counselling',
          'Peer support group'
      )
      OR h.linkages_and_refferals IN (
          'Livelihood support',
          'Legal Support',
          'Educational Support',
          'Spiritual support/counseling-Prayer',
          'Peer support group',
          'Individual counseling',
          'Sexual and Reproductive Health Services',
          'Mental Health Care/Rehabilitation',
          'Gender Based Violance'
      )
      OR h.art_preparation IN (
          'ART Literacy',
          'Adherence preparation and plan',
          'Ongoing Adherence counselling and support',
          'Intensive Adherence counsellingand support',
          'Intensive Adherence counseling and support',
          'Appointment tracking and followup of lost clients',
          'Pre-ART Counseling'
      )
      OR h.prevention_components IN (
          'Alcohol and Substance abuse reduction',
          'Risk Reduction Counselling',
          'Management of Stigma and Discrimination',
          'Basic Care package'
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
